facts.fact: Africa Check says the DRC has no access to information law, and that deputy Jacques Djoli filed a bill on access to information and transparency of public life at the National Assembly in October 2024, not yet adopted.
facts.system: Proposition de loi portant sur l'accès à l'information et la transparence de la vie publique

systems.system: Proposition de loi portant sur l'accès à l'information et la transparence de la vie publique

COD.note: The document says nothing about an open data policy.
The document names no data published for download by a public body.
Only a CSAC order threatening sanctions and a minister's threat of the death penalty; no arrest, charge, closure or cut is reported, and no named policy is criticised by a named body.
The document says nothing about police station records.
